state:
Goal `core-taint-and-1-more`: `Core\Taint` is complete, and so are `Core\Task::afterResponse` and
`Core\Task::all`. `all` has about, a Rust test in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/task.rs`'s `mod tests`
(a `Serial` host that runs a group's jobs in order), three examples, three attacks, one bench with
its record, and a card in the plain voice. The card rewrite also rewrote the rows `map` shares with
`all`: `LIMIT_DOC`, `DEADLINE_DOC` and `GROUP_ERRORS`. Two of `all`'s attacks found bugs too large
for a slice, and each is a gap record owned by M10, marked on its attack:
`nvs-host/a-task-stack-is-not-charged-to-its-request` (nested groups pass the memory limit) and
`nvs-host/a-task-that-never-waits-outlives-its-groups-deadline` (a busy child ignores `deadline`).
`Core\Task::map` is untaken, and it is the last item of the goal. Nothing is blocked.

items.text: **`Core\Task::map`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, tests, and `MAP_DOC` rewritten in the plain voice the way `ALL_DOC` now is (the shared `LIMIT_DOC`, `DEADLINE_DOC` and `GROUP_ERRORS` are already done). The `Serial` host asserts `Bounds::default()`, so a test naming an option needs its own counter or a relaxed assert. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/task.rs:234`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/task.rs:492`

backlog: The busy-child and stack-charge gaps are security findings (priority 1): a request escapes its memory cap and a group escapes its `deadline`. `data/gaps/nvs-host/`, owner M10.
`tests/conformance/core/a-task-all-answers-a-shape-each-field-keeping-its-own-type.nvst`'s comment still says the scheduler half is not on disk; it is. Owner: goal `plain-comments`.
`[limits] max_tasks` is read by nothing (`crates/nvs-config/src/default.toml`), and `rule:security/isolate-budget-is-the-trees` counts child tasks against it. Owner: the stack-charge gap above.
